piezas.titulo: Production practice: Opinion essay and structure
texto: Closing the Superior stage (CU-TFL Superior / TPA T4): an oral and written simulation of high discursive demand. At this level you have consolidated the ability to articulate abstract reasoning, structure multi-paragraph texts with cultivated connectors, respond to counter-arguments and defend complex positions with academic composure. In the final test, speak fluently about your judgement on a civic dilemma and summarise the conclusions of your essay orally, with impeccable courtesy and tonal precision.
